source_level_before: Known/repository-positive scope included long-range expanders, NM13-01 line-graph and arc-truncation non-LRE classes, and P26 finite-fiber lexicographic transfers; no general vertex-transitive spectral-expander theorem.
source_level_after: Adds twisted finite-group Cayley thickenings: for a fixed finite fiber Cayley graph and arbitrary inverse-compatible generator twists, any Salez-continuous-time cutoff Cayley base transfers cutoff after time rescaling (d+s)/d, with the same order window; for Ramanujan/LRE Cayley bases this gives bounded-degree vertex-transitive spectral expanders outside uniform LRE with O(sqrt(log n)) cutoff window.
quantitative_center_application: If the d-regular base has center d/(d-2) log_{d-1}|Gamma_n| and O(sqrt(log |Gamma_n|)) window, the twisted degree-(d+s) output has center (d+s)/(d-2) log_{d-1}|Gamma_n| and O(sqrt(log |Gamma_n|)) window.
spectral_transfer: gap(output) >= min{ d/(d+s) gap(base), s/(d+s) gap(fiber) }.
tv_transfer: d_base(a t) <= d_output(t) <= d_base(a t) + (1/2)sqrt(|K|-1) exp(-b gamma_F t), where a=d/(d+s), b=s/(d+s).
non_lre: For N=|Gamma_n||K| and D=d+s, balls satisfy |B_H(r)| <= C_{d,K}(d-1)^r; at r=floor((1/2)log_{D-1}N), any LRE constant is O(N^{-beta}) with beta=(1/2)(1-log_{D-1}(d-1))>0.
mechanism_progress: Finite-state entropy disintegration removes the prior arc-transitivity entropy-synchronization obstruction: if H(Y)>=log n-Delta and J has at most m states, sum_j p_j(log n-H(Y|J=j)) <= Delta+H(J); persistent directed-edge orbit types therefore inherit near-maximal entropy without arc-transitivity. For fixed degree, the NBRW directed-edge orbit process has at most d states and transition probabilities in multiples of 1/(d-1); transient orbit mass is uniformly exponentially small and persistent types have uniformly positive mass along their periodic support.
remaining_obstruction: The general Salez conjecture still lacks a mechanism proving near-maximal NBRW endpoint entropy (or an equivalent Green/varentropy condition) from vertex transitivity plus spectral expansion. Tree-rate/pre-entropic LRE cannot be forced by those source hypotheses. Orbital synchronization is no longer the blocker; accumulated collision/transport structure is.
